en.headline: Second-child baby bonus rises to HK$30,000 under 11 fertility measures
en.dek: The existing HK$20,000 newborn bonus is extended for three years, while tax allowance for second and subsequent children also increases, Chief Executive John Lee said.
body: Hong Kong will raise the cash bonus for second and subsequent children to HK$30,000 and extend the existing newborn bonus scheme for another three years, Chief Executive John Lee announced on Wednesday.

In his Policy Address, Lee said the HK$20,000 newborn baby bonus, due to expire in October, would continue for three more years. For the second or subsequent child born on or after the day of the address, the bonus would rise to HK$30,000 for a three-year period.

The tax allowance for such children would also increase from HK$140,000 to HK$160,000. Lee said the current-term government had shifted from a non-interventionist approach to actively promoting fertility and creating a more conducive environment for childbearing.
The changes form part of 11 new measures aimed at encouraging residents to have children, including housing-related incentives for parents with newborns.

zh.headline: 第二胎新生嬰兒獎勵金增至3萬元 生育措施共11項
zh.dek: 行政長官宣布現有2萬元新生嬰兒獎勵金計劃延長三年，第二名及之後子女獎勵金提高至3萬元，相關免稅額亦上調。
body: 行政長官李家超周三宣布，政府會將第二名及之後子女的新生嬰兒現金獎勵提高至3萬元，並將現有2萬元新生嬰兒獎勵金計劃延長三年。
李家超在《施政報告》中表示，原定10月到期的2萬元新生嬰兒獎勵金計劃會再延續三年。自施政報告發表當日或之後出生的第二名及之後子女，獎勵金將提高至3萬元，為期三年。
相關子女的免稅額亦會由14萬元增至16萬元。李家超指，本屆政府已由不干預轉向積極推動生育，致力營造更有利的生育環境。
有關改動屬11項鼓勵生育新措施的一部分，當中亦包括為有新生嬰兒家庭提供住屋相關誘因。
